summary: BAKSKJUL ØVRE GÅRD V/ ENGEBRÅTEN (org. no. 929 775 422) is a sole proprietorship (ENK) based in Tønsberg, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2022-09-06. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 01.110 (Dyrking av korn, unntatt ris, belgvekster og oljeholdige vekster); it has 0 registered employees.
